description: Source code implementing a cache for MIME supportability information, including functions for parsing MIME attributes, managing cache entries, and supporting supportability queries based on bitrate.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of MIME supportability information, including support for bitrate-based queries and cache management.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache::Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry containing parsed MIME info and bitrate support bounds.

methods.name: RemoveAttributeFromMime
methods.description: Removes a specified attribute from a MIME string, returning the modified string and optionally the attribute value.

methods.name: StripAndParseBitrate
methods.description: Removes the 'bitrate' attribute from a MIME string and parses its integer value.

methods.name: GetMimeSupportability
methods.description: Returns supportability info for a given MIME string, considering bitrate support.

methods.name: CacheMimeSupportability
methods.description: Caches supportability info for a MIME string with a specified supportability status.

methods.name: ClearCachedMimeSupportabilities
methods.description: Clears all cached MIME supportability entries.

methods.name: DumpCache
methods.description: Outputs the current cache state for debugging.

methods.name: GetEntry_Locked
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache entry for a given MIME string.

methods.name: IsBitrateSupported_Locked
methods.description: Determines if a bitrate is supported based on cache entry bounds.

methods.name: UpdateBitrateSupportability_Locked
methods.description: Updates cache entry bounds based on supportability of a specific bitrate.
